name: hedge_v_a

variant_by_position.note: Pick hedge_v_a when tile y % 3 == 0, hedge_v_b when y % 3 == 1, hedge_v_c when y % 3 == 2. hedge_v is an alias of hedge_v_a. Same pattern as wall_v. The three tiles were built from one foliage texture so a,b,c cycle along a north-south run.

note: Alias of hedge_v. Tileable north-south, heightTiles 1.
